text:
felix (AE): quick presales thread for EmeraldBank POC. they want tenant traffic pinned to EU with BYOK for model keys, but will accept an emergency cross-border contingency to APAC. they want: (1) a capped monthly egress credit (not billing), (2) an auditable subprocessor escrow (copy of certs placed with escrow agent), and (3) clear counting rules for what counts as a failover. any take?

meera (SE): short answers: hosted can do affinity + prefer-region; BYOK + subproc escrow pushes toward Dedicated/Private. we can offer a hosted + contingency add-on: reserved EU pool + egress credit cap + escrowed subproc attestations that we refresh monthly.

felix (AE): buyer insists escrowed artifacts are controlled by an independent escrow agent and only released with a signed incident report. can we do that?

chantel (Legal): we can do an addendum: (A) contractual egress credit cap, (B) deposit of current subprocessor attestations into a neutral escrow (vendor to be agreed), and (C) release conditions limited to documented, counted emergencies. need exact release conditions, max incidents, and whether they want redaction of operational IPs.

yuki (Infra): technical notes: hosted fallback path default: eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 -> ap-southeast-1. public-hosted APAC uses partner infra 'apac-node-1' and log forwarder 'logbridge-ap'. if escrow required for certs, we can package SOC2 + ISO27001 PDFs monthly. BYOK requires Dedicated/Private for key-rotation control. we can produce signed route-change events with an HMAC and S3 export to customer.

paul (Sales Eng): pricing constructs: Option 1: Hosted + EU reserved pool + escrow + monthly egress credit cap. Option 2: Dedicated (BYOK + subproc exclusion) + migration assistance. Ballpark: reserved pool adds ~30% so recommended for production POC; escrow + credit add-on is a fixed monthly fee (e.g., €1k-2k depending on cert handling), plus the egress credit cap (example 1TB included). I'll firm numbers after infra confirms cost to maintain escrow.

felix (AE): Chantel 1 can you draft a short escrow & contingency addendum we can give the buyer? Yuki 1 confirm what subprocessors would be touched during APAC fallback and how quickly we can provide PDFs to the escrow agent. Meera 1 can you provide a simple runbook for counting failovers we can reference?

chantel (Legal): will draft an addendum. needs: (a) exact fallback target(s) to enumerate, (b) max incidents/month for credit, (c) release criteria for escrowed artifacts (e.g., more than 50% of tenant traffic in 60s window served outside EU and duration >30s), (d) whether customer needs full IPs redacted.

yuki (Infra): can confirm: we'll limit fallback to ap-southeast-1 only per request. subprocessors that may be involved: "apac-node-1" (compute), "logbridge-ap" (log forwarding), and optionally "cdn-edge-ap". we can push cert PDFs to an escrow agent within 3 business days of each monthly snapshot. signed route-change events (with HMAC) available within 1 hour of event; we push to s3://emeraldbank-audit/2876543210/ by default.

meera (SE): runbook snippet (for contract reference):
```yaml
tenant_affinity: eu
preferred_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
fallback_region: ap-southeast-1
failover_definition: "an incident counts when >50% of tenant requests in any 60s window originate from fallback_region and fallback_duration >= 30s"
max_qualified_failovers_per_month: 3
egress_credit: "monthly cap applies; credits issued after event validation"
audit_sink: s3://emeraldbank-audit/
```

meera (SE): measurement notes: we'll emit request-id + region + sha256(route) per request. validation will be done by ops and legal for credit issuance.

chantel (Legal): that definition is actionable. i'll include it in the addendum and add a 5-business-day SLA for providing escrow snapshots. also will include redaction rules for any IPs that are operationally sensitive.

paul (Sales Eng): i'll prepare a quote with two line items: (A) reserved EU capacity (monthly commit), (B) escrow & egress contingency add-on (fixed fee + included 1TB credit). Dedicated quote optional. will flag all numbers as draft.

ci-bot: fallback-sim: EU pool at 95% on 2028-05-10T02:17:11Z, fallback to ap-southeast-1 for 45s (simulated); signed route-change event pushed to s3://redwood-ci/fallbacks/2876543210.log :white_check_mark:

felix (AE): excellent. Chantel + Paul 1 once you have draft addendum + pricing i'll send to buyer and request escrow vendor details. thanks all.
